summary: Registers a scene file in the scene registry: strips the extension (after the last '.') and the directory prefix (after the last '\') from the input path a3 to derive a base filename, searches the scene registry array (dword_8AC488 entries, stride 396, names at entry+260) for a match, creates a new empty entry when absent, stores the full original path into the entry, writes season races data, then computes and stores a formatted scene-file-path result at entry+392 and returns it.

local_names.v10: byte offset from buffer to entry
local_names.result: formatted scene file path from SceneFilePathFormatter

operations.description: Scan a3 backwards from its terminator for the last '.' (46) to strip the file extension; when found, overwrite it with a NUL (set *v4 = 0).
Scan a3 backwards for the last '\' (92) to strip the directory prefix; when found, advance one byte past it so v5 points at the base filename after the final separator.
Call StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v14, "%s", v5) to copy the base filename into the local v14 buffer using the aS_4 format string.
Search the registry only when dword_8AC488 (registered scene count) is greater than 0.

Iterate scene entries at stride 396 starting from a4 + 260, comparing each entry name against the base filename via sub_588410; break when sub_588410 returns 0 (match found), incrementing v6 per entry until v6 reaches dword_8AC488.

When the search exhausted (v6 == dword_8AC488) the name is new: zero the first byte of the empty entry at a4 + 396*v6 + 260, copy the base filename from v14 into it byte-by-byte, then increment dword_8AC488.
Store the full original path a3 into the selected entry (v12 + 4) via strcpy.
Call SeasonRacesSectionWriter(a3) to write season races section data for this scene file.
Call SceneFilePathFormatter(a3, 115, 211) and assign its result.
Store the formatted result into the entry at offset 392 (*(_DWORD *)(v12 + 392) = result).
Return the formatted scene file path result.
